text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound. It is also helpful to divide a large project into milestones, so you can track your progress and celebrate small wins along the way. Deliverables, such as reports or final products, show exactly what the team must complete. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters a lot. When everyone, from team members to clients, agrees on the goals from the start, the project runs more smoothly and avoids unnecessary misunderstandings later.
